note: Hand-written stand-in for a model response so the demo runs without an API key. Re-record with --llm record.

output.explanation: Refunds were still sent to /v1/payments/capture/{id}/refund, part of the v1 Payments API that PayPal has deprecated. This moves the call to the Payments v2 refund endpoint, changing the body to the v2 shape ({ value, currency_code }). Because it is a new money-moving call, it also gets a PayPal-Request-Id derived from the capture id, so a retried refund cannot pay out twice.
